summary: Approved. The trigger direction, bounded intensity math, default profile behavior, and SetIntensity call shape are consistent with the requested live flashlight controls. No blocking correctness or regression issues were found.
work_completed: Reviewed examples/flashlight/run.py trigger parsing, analog axis normalization, bounded intensity calculation, and live loop integration.
Verified left trigger decreases and right trigger increases intensity via examples/flashlight/run.py:112-118 and examples/flashlight/run.py:288-331.
Verified runtime SetIntensity call uses the existing SPEAR/Unreal keyword shape NewIntensity, matching examples/flashlight/run.py:910 and docs/agents.mcp_usage.md:215.

Checked default, realistic_live_flashlight, and realistic_live_flashlight_2x parsed controls with PYTHONPATH=python import smoke: default 1500/1500/0/15000/0.05, realistic 800/1000/0/8000/0.05, realistic_2x 1600/1600/0/16000/0.05.
Ran python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation: 93 tests passed.
Ran python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py successfully.

findings.message: examples/flashlight/run.py:288-331 correctly computes delta as (right trigger - left trigger) * rate * elapsed time, clamps to --intensity-min/--intensity-max, and applies SetIntensity(NewIntensity=...) only when the value changes.

examples/flashlight/run.py:139-157 gives realistic/default profiles usable bounded controls: non-negative finite rate/min/max, min <= max, current intensity inside bounds, deadzone in [0, 1), default rate at least 1000, and default max large enough for 10x current or 5 seconds of adjustment.

tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:585-609 and tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:947-1007 cover defaults, trigger direction, clamping, and runtime SetIntensity application, but do not cover invalid new CLI bounds/deadzone cases or realistic profile derived defaults. This is a non-blocking coverage gap because the implementation path itself was reviewed and smoke-checked.

Live validation with an actual display/gamepad session was not performed in this review; verification was limited to repository tests, syntax compilation, static review, and parsed-default smoke checks.

follow_up_recommendations: Add focused parser tests for --intensity-min > --intensity-max, --intensity outside configured bounds, non-finite/negative --intensity-adjust-rate, and --intensity-trigger-deadzone boundary values.
Run the live flashlight example in a display-capable gamepad session to tune operator feel for the 0.05 deadzone and default adjustment rate.
memory_worthy: Inspector approved live flashlight trigger intensity controls; no blocking issues found. Non-blocking gap: parser/deadzone boundary tests for new CLI controls are still missing.
